title: 遊樂場代幣
question:
遊樂場的代幣有 1 點、4 點、5 點三種。請輸入要換的點數，輸出最少要幾枚代幣。
想想看：先拿最大的代幣，一定最少嗎？

en.title: Arcade Tokens
en.question:
An arcade has tokens worth 1, 4, and 5 points. Input the points you need. Output the fewest tokens.
Think: If you always take the biggest token first, is that always the fewest?
